title: Alumni Jobs and Internships - KIT's College of Engineering Kolhapur
text:
ALUMNI JOBS AND INTERNSHIPS — KITCOEK

The KITCOEK Alumni Association maintains a job and internship portal exclusively for KITCOEK alumni and students, connecting graduates with opportunities from companies that trust KITCOEK talent.

RECENT JOB POSTINGS
- KEC International Limited — Engineer (Full-Time), 1 year experience, Bangalore, Karnataka (2024)
- Biocon Biologics Ltd — Executive role, 2 years experience (2024)

ABOUT THE ALUMNI ASSOCIATION
The KITCoEK Alumni Association connects alumni with:
- Career opportunities at top companies
- Mentorship programs for current students
- Internship openings posted by alumni working in industry
- Networking events and alumni meets
- Knowledge sharing and guidance sessions

HOW ALUMNI HELP CURRENT STUDENTS
- Campus recruitment drives organized through alumni network
- Resume review and mock interview sessions
- Industry internship facilitation
- Higher studies guidance (abroad and domestic)
- Entrepreneurship mentoring

NOTABLE ALUMNI
KITCOEK alumni are working at top organizations including:
- Wipro, TCS, Infosys, Cognizant
- Adani Group, L&T, Forbes Marshall
- Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC)
- International universities (USA, Germany, Australia)
- Startups and entrepreneurial ventures

Alumni Portal: https://www.kitcoek.in/alumni
Jobs Portal: https://www.kitcoek.in/alumni-jobs
Contact Alumni Cell: alumni@kitcoek.in
